decision_conditions:
<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left:18.0pt">The proposed two storey rear
extension, by reason of excessive bulk and massing and large crown roof, would
form an incongruous, discordant, unduly bulky and dominant addition to the host
dwelling which would fail to preserve or enhance the character and appearance
of the South Hill Avenue Conservation Area,&nbsp;and the Area of Special
Character and there is not clear and convincing justification for the harm, nor
public benefits to outweigh them.&nbsp;The development is therefore contrary to
the high quality design aspirations of National Planning Policy Framework
(2024), Policies D3.D(1) and D3.D(11) and HC1 of the London Plan (2021), Core
Policy CS1.B and D of The Harrow Core Strategy (2012), Policies DM1, DM6 and
DM7 of Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013); the adopted
Supplementary Planning Document: South Hill Avenue Conservation Area Appraisal
and Management Strategy (2008) and the adopted Supplementary Planning Document:
Residential Design Guide (2010).&nbsp; &nbsp;<o:p></o:p></p>
description: Planning approval is sought for the conversion of garage to habitable room, replacement garage doors in front elevation, two storey side to rear extension, rear dormers, juliette balcony to first floor rear elevation, external alterations, 1.2m timber gate to front, alterations to the front hardstanding and rear patio.
